test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The "Wood's Despatch" of 1854 recommended several significant changes in the Indian education system.

Which of the following was a key recommendation of this despatch?

options.text: The immediate vernacularization of all levels of education.
The establishment of a comprehensive system of education from the primary to the university level, with English as the medium of instruction at higher levels.
The complete privatization of the education sector in India.
The exclusive focus on the training of religious leaders and scholars.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The establishment of a comprehensive system of education from the primary to the university level, with English as the medium of instruction at higher levels.**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wood's Despatch** of **1854** is famously known as the **Magna Carta of English Education in India**, as it was the first document to provide a comprehensive plan for the spread of education.
 
• Prepared by **Sir Charles Wood**, the then President of the **Board of Control**, the despatch was addressed to **Lord Dalhousie**, the Governor-General of India.
 
• It proposed a **structured educational hierarchy** consisting of **Primary Schools** at the bottom, followed by **Middle Schools**, **High Schools**, **Colleges**, and **Universities**.
 
• The despatch recommended that **English** be the medium of instruction for **higher education** (University level) while **vernacular languages** (local mother tongues) be used at the **school level** to ensure wider reach.
 
• It advised the establishment of **Universities** in the presidency towns of **Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras**, modeled after the **University of London**, to regulate and conduct examinations.

 **Additional Information__**

 
• **Administrative Framework**:
 
 
• It recommended the creation of a **Department of Public Instruction (DPI)** in every province to supervise educational activities and maintain standards.
 
 
 
• **Financial Support and Privatization**:
 
 
• To encourage **private enterprise**, the despatch introduced the **Grant-in-Aid system** for private schools that provided **secular education** and met government standards.
 
 
 
• **Social Initiatives**:
 
 
• The document placed significant emphasis on **Women's Education** and **Vocational Training**, advocating for the establishment of **Normal Schools** to train professional teachers.
 
 
 
• **Secular Focus**:
 
 
• It mandated that education in **government-aided institutions** must remain strictly **secular**, although private institutions were allowed to include religious instruction.
